conflicts.permit: Your e-mail address can be the only data that we might acquire about you.
conflicts.prohibit: Our company has developed applications which are not intended to collect any personal nor non-personal information about the users.
conflicts.situation: When a user contacts the company by email with questions regarding the privacy policy.
